title: Quantum Entanglement Measures of Cosmological Squeezed States in Starobinsky Inflation
description: Studies quantum correlations generated during inflation using the Mukhanov–Sasaki formalism, characterizing squeezed-state entanglement and negativity as diagnostics of the quantum-to-classical transition of cosmological perturbations.

title: Dark Matter Phenomenology: Thermal Freeze-Out & Relic Density
description: Investigated thermal freeze-out dynamics of WIMP-like dark matter candidates and computed relic abundance, connecting Boltzmann-equation solutions to present-day cosmological constraints.
